message: ingress-nginx matches "/[A-Z]{3}" as a case-insensitive regular expression anchored only at the start. A RegularExpression match with the same value matches fewer requests on gateways that match the whole path case-sensitively.

fix.summary: Match the path as a case-insensitive regular expression that also accepts longer paths. RegularExpression support and syntax are implementation-specific, so confirm your Gateway accepts the (?i) flag.
